events.title: The Call Of The Drum
events.time: 6:30 PM · Island Park, Island Park, 441 Crescent Rd E, R1N 3X2,, Portage la prairie, MB
events.description: Call of the Drum at Island Park Featuring Broken Walls In preparation for the National Day for Truth and Reconciliation, the community is invited to gather for Call of the Drum on September 18 at 6:30 p.m. at Island Park in Portage la Prairie. This free community event offers an opportunity to come together in a spirit of learning, reflection, celebration, and connection. The evening will feature Broken Walls, an acclaimed Indigenous rock band known for their powerful storytelling, energetic performances, and messages of resilience, hope, and unity. Through music and shared experiences, attendees will have the opportunity to celebrate Indigenous culture while reflecting on the importance of truth and reconciliation. A special guest appearance by Island Breeze will add to the evening's celebration, bringing even more music, energy, and community spirit to this meaningful gathering. Call of the Drum will showcase a variety of cultural performances and activities, including drumming, singing, dancing, songs, and stories. These performances and teachings highlight the richness of Indigenous cultures while creating a welcoming space for community members of all ages to come together, learn, celebrate the Creator, and strengthen community connections. The drum is often referred to as the heartbeat of the people, bringing communities together through rhythm, connection, and shared understanding. As we approach the National Day for Truth and Reconciliation, this gathering offers a meaningful opportunity to honor Indigenous voices, celebrate culture, and strengthen relationships within our community. Event Details Event: Call of the Drum Date: September 18 Time: 6:30 p.m. Location: Island Park, Portage la Prairie (The Ukrainian Connection Bandstand) Rain Venue: Prairie Vineyard Featuring: Broken Walls Guest Appearance: Island Breeze Activities: Drumming, singing, dancing, songs, and stories Admission: Free Everyone is welcome to attend this free event and experience an evening of music, culture, and community. Join us at Island Park as we come together to celebrate Indigenous cultures, promote understanding, and prepare for the National Day for Truth and Reconciliation. Come feel the rhythm, share in the experience, and be part of a memorable evening in Portage la Prairie.

events.title: Home Routes Concerts at WAC: "When We Became Folk Fest" Film Screening w/Debra Lyn Neufeld
events.time: 7:00 PM · Winkler Arts and Culture, 547 Park St,, Winkler, Manitoba
events.description: We’re kicking off our 2026-2027 concert season with something a little different! Winnipeg filmmaker Kevin Nikkel joins us for a screening of his feature documentary When We Became Folk Fest, exploring the first two years of the Winnipeg Folk Festival through archival footage filmed in 1974 and 1975. The film captures the early days of what would become an important part of Winnipeg’s cultural landscape, including Home Routes co-founder Mitch Podolak at the beginning of his career as a presenter and festival director. Watch the preview here! Following the screening, Kevin will stick around for a conversation and Q&A about the footage, the beginnings of the festival and the community that formed around it. And it wouldn’t be a Home Routes evening without some live music! Winnipeg blues singer and musician Debra Lyn Neufeld will also join us for a short live set. Buy your tickets for this concert, as well as others in the series at www.winklerarts.com/2026-27-concert-series/

events.title: The Big Canoe
events.time: 9:00 AM · Lake Minnewasta, 100 Colert Road, Morden, MB
events.description: Join us for The Big Canoe, a one-of-a-kind outdoor learning experience at Lake Minnewasta on Saturday, September 19. This event brings together culture, history, adventure, and community connection. Register here: https://morden.ca/events/big-canoe Presented through a partnership between the City of Morden and Wilderland Adventure Company, this immersive event is designed to connect participants with Métis culture, local history, and hands-on outdoor education through engaging land- and water-based activities. Participants will rotate through interactive small-group sessions throughout the day, including: • Voyageur Canoe Experience — Paddle aboard a large-capacity voyageur canoe while learning teamwork, paddling skills, canoe safety, local history, and the legacy of the Voyageurs. • Scavenger Hunt — Explore the natural landscape through a nature-based scavenger hunt with a self-guided hike. • Fire Making & Bannock — Learn traditional outdoor fire-making skills and enjoy Bannock cooking over the fire. A special highlight of the day will be a storytelling and cultural presentation led by a Métis educator, Georges Beaudry, open to all participants and guests from 12:30 PM – 1:30 PM. Hosted along the shoreline and natural surroundings of Lake Minnewasta, The Big Canoe offers a welcoming and immersive environment for youth, families, and community members to learn, explore, and connect outdoors. This program is supported by funding from Southern Health-Santé Sud and Healthy Together Now through the Creating Community Connections Grant.

events.title: Active Approach to Osteoarthritis
events.time: 7:30 PM · RISE, 245 Kimberly Road, Winkler, MB
events.description: Learn how movement, strength, nutrition, and lifestyle can help you manage osteoarthritis, reduce symptoms, and stay active. Join us for a FREE practical workshop on managing osteoarthritis and staying active as you age, with a focus on knee and hip osteoarthritis. We’ll break down what osteoarthritis is, what it means for your joints, and how movement and strength can play an important role in managing symptoms and improving function. You’ll also learn how nutrition and everyday lifestyle habits can support joint health and help you continue doing the activities you enjoy. The workshop will combine education with practical strategies and exercises you can apply both inside and outside the gym. *MUST Pre-Register, use the link below.
